digest.component_or_area: completion verifier wrapper and phase timing
propositions: 237743.4 ms of the verifier_call_ms=423502 interval remains unattributed by inner verifier total_ms=185758.6, indicating unidentified wrapper/dispatch overhead that must be directly measured.

Direct monotonic timers at call-graph seams (wrapper, attempt, handle resolution, dispatch, annotation, finalization) must partition the wrapper interval without adding I/O, subprocesses, network calls, retries, locks, or traversals.

Named direct child phases plus wrapper overhead must reconcile to verifier_call_ms with maximum 10 ms discrepancy, with any larger difference explicitly labeled unattributed_verifier_ms rather than causally inferred.
Existing consumption metrics (llm_ms, det_ms, total_ms, requests, tool_calls) and repeated-pass/resume/drain workload counts must remain unchanged while being counted during existing traversals.
Instrumentation must operate as an optional metrics collector parameter threaded through existing calls, preserving behavior of callers that supply no collector.
Focused model-backed tests for both PASS and FAIL verdict sidecars must directly attribute phases and reconcile partition arithmetic with <1 ms per phase rounding tolerance.
